sections.Profile:
"Soccer" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in March 1964. Designed by Norm Clark, the game features a soccer theme, with artwork depicting players and stadium scenes. The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, one passive bumper, two slingshots, six standup targets, two kick-out holes, two rollover buttons, and a ball kicker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Soccer, Sports
